bullets.text: A man named Saravanan died after being run over by a truck in Madhavaram, and the office should monitor police reports from the Avadi Commissionerate.
Two cows and a deer died due to electrocution near Ponneri, and local officials should inspect power safety in that area.
A special education loan camp is being held at the Thiruvallur government hospital, and the office should track student participation levels.
Reddit is testing search ads due to traffic drops from Google AI, and our IT portfolio team should watch these shifts in digital advertising.

stories.title: Man run over by truck near Madhavarm
takeaways: A forty-four year old man named Saravanan died after being run over by a truck in Madhavaram.
The incident highlights local road safety concerns requiring attention from the district police administration.

stories.title: மின்சாரம் பாய்ந்து 2 மாடுகள், மான் உயிரழப்பு
takeaways: Two cattle and a deer died due to electrocution in Anuppambattu, Ponneri.
District authorities must investigate power line safety to prevent future accidents.

stories.title: திருவள்ளூரில் இன்று கல்வி கடன் முகாம்
takeaways: Thiruvallur district administration organized a special education loan camp at the government hospital today.
Students in the district can utilize this opportunity to secure financial assistance for higher education.

stories.title: Governor presents Unit Citations to Air Force Station, Avadi, 27 Special Composite Group of National Security Guard
takeaways: Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar awarded Unit Citations to Air Force Station Avadi and the NSG group.
The event highlights military excellence and security preparedness within the Thiruvallur district administrative region.

stories.title: Reddit Tests Search Ads as Google AI Cuts Traffic
takeaways: Social media platform Reddit is introducing search ads following traffic drops caused by artificial intelligence search tools.
The shift reflects broader global industry trends in digital advertising and artificial intelligence search integration.
